body: scripts/game_state.py: serialize_snapshot() parses PacketSnapshot bytes (18b/entity: id+scene+x+y+z+yaw) into GPT-2 natural-language token string; decode_action() parses action token string to UserCmd field dict; encode_action() serializes bot inputs back to tokens for replay logging. 14 unit tests in scripts/test_game_state.py — all pass. Round-trip encode→decode→re-encode stable.
title: S39-01: game state serializer + action decoder
